Warm up before intense exercise and stop if you feel pain or dizziness. For information only — not medical advice.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose your level: beginner, intermediate, or advanced.
  2. Enter the total workout duration in minutes (5-60).
  3. Click Generate workout.
  4. Follow the round table: exercise, work seconds, rest seconds, and elapsed time.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are the intervals set?

Beginner: 30s work / 30s rest; intermediate: 40s / 20s; advanced: 50s / 10s, with a warm-up and cool-down around the rounds.

What if my duration is short?

Warm-up and cool-down shrink automatically so at least one work round always fits.

Can I repeat the workout?

Yes. Generating again with the same settings gives the same plan, so you can track progress.
